global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with visible pork fat. Toppings—halved soft-boiled egg, chashu, and green onions—are artfully arranged in a patterned bowl, set against a dark wooden table under warm, ambient light.

regions.background: Dark brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and subtle sheen under ambient lighting.
regions.bowl: The ceramic bowl has a white base, red rim, and decorative black Japanese characters with orange-red floral motifs.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, smooth with subtle bubbles and faint noodle strands visible beneath its surface.
regions.cut_egg: A halved boiled egg shows a vibrant orange yolk, translucent white, and a glossy surface with a small green speck.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, slightly fatty texture with visible marbling and a glossy surface beneath a dark brown sauce.
